licence.renewsTogether.value: Lease and licence are renewed together in one application and paid on one renewal invoice. The P.O. Box renewal receipt is also required. Other items: audited financial statements (FZE or FZC), a certificate of good standing for branches, sector approvals, and building and safety certificates for land tenants. The applicant must have signed and collected the tenancy contract.
licence.renewsTogether.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), SAIF Zone, renews together (official SAIF Zone Application for Lease and License Renewal (Feb 2019), CONFIRMED. Official FAQ: facilities are on long term leases, renewable, with yearly payment); https://www.saif-zone.com/media/g4jdbl4i/renewal_form.pdf ; https://www.saif-zone.com/en/faq/

licence.afterExpiry.value: A cancelled company can be restored by paying the required amounts. No grace period or day thresholds are stated.
